title: New in CLO-SET: Meet CLOFAB, Your Built-In Fabric Digitization Tool
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/3de990f60a4142f89d89c71343351c6d/images/01b911185c4f4426a43ed8bb9fc5a010whatsnew-1-clofab.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/3de990f60a4142f89d89c71343351c6d/images/3bfec9933aa8477e93c17e00a36fba21CLOFAB%20in%20CLO-SET.png)Accurate digital fabrics are the foundation of every reliable 3D garment — and building them should be simple for everyone in the supply chain, not just 3D specialists.

Today we’re introducing **CLOFAB in CLO-SET** : a web-based fabric digitization tool that lets you create, register, and share digital fabric assets right in your browser. No separate software installation, and no CLO license required. Scan physical samples with the AI-powered **CLO zFab Kit** , or start from fabric images you already have — either way, CLOFAB turns them into simulation-ready digital fabrics in minutes.

Whether you’re a fabric mill building a digital library for your buyers, a vendor responding to digital-first RFQs, or a brand digitizing seasonal materials, CLOFAB works right inside the platform your team already uses.

![a794c90538d7487a9461c9a9d53fb084](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/3de990f60a4142f89d89c71343351c6d/images/a794c90538d7487a9461c9a9d53fb084image.png)

## Why We Built CLOFAB into CLO-SET

If you’ve tried digitizing fabrics before, you know the frustrations: results that vary from operator to operator, equipment that takes training to run, and outputs trapped in specialist tools your partners can’t open. Meanwhile, suppliers and mills face growing pressure to deliver digital fabric data alongside physical samples — and adopting a whole new toolchain just for digitization creates friction for everyone.

CLOFAB was built to remove exactly that friction. It runs on the web inside CLO-SET — no CLO license needed — so anyone with a CLO-SET account can digitize fabrics and share them instantly with design teams, buyers, and partners. Behind it sits the **CLO zFab Kit** : the zFab Cutter, Scanner, and Draper work together to measure how a fabric looks and behaves from one small round swatch, guided by AI models built on fabric data from CLO and swatchbook. For your team, that means shipping fewer physical swatches, approving materials sooner, and making decisions on data everyone can trust.

## What You Can Do with CLOFAB

### Generate Seamless Fabric Maps with AI Auto Tiling

Capture high-resolution PBR maps — including Diffuse, Normal, Roughness, Opacity, and Displacement — from physical samples with the **CLO zFab Scanner** , or open your existing map images.

From there, CLOFAB’s **Auto Tiling** uses AI pattern recognition to do the hard part for you: click and drag to select a repeat area on your map, and CLOFAB automatically finds the optimal repeat region and previews the seamless, tileable result. Need more control? Switch to Manual Mode to define the repeat area yourself, and use the Equalize option to smooth out uneven brightness across the tiled result.

![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60238599476761)

### Generate Accurate Drape from Fabric Specs

A digital fabric isn’t complete without physical properties. With CLOFAB’s drape generation, simply enter your **fabric type, composition, weight, and thickness** — and CLOFAB computes the physical property data and previews the drape instantly. You can review the map and physical properties side by side, then fine-tune individual values in Advanced Details when needed.

![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60238599478681)

### Upload and Share Fabrics Instantly

Once your maps and physical properties are ready, upload them to CLO-SET as a fabric file in a few clicks. Add the fabric name, supplier, and owner information, choose a Workroom or Company Library, and your digital fabric is immediately available to your entire team — versioned, searchable, and ready to use in 3D garments, with no conversions or cleanup in between.

## Built for Suppliers, Loved by Brands

For **fabric suppliers and mills** , CLOFAB is the fastest way to build a digital fabric library your customers can actually use — without investing in new software or training. For **brands and design teams** , it means receiving accurate, simulation-ready fabric data from partners directly in CLO-SET, cutting out file conversions and back-and-forth emails.

The result: a faster, more connected 3D workflow across your entire supply chain.

## How to Get Started

CLOFAB is available now in CLO-SET. To try it, click the **CLOFAB** button in the bottom-left corner of your dashboard, or select **\+ NEW → Create New Fabric** in any Workroom or Company Library.

For step-by-step instructions, check out the [CLOFAB in CLO-SET guide](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/60222735538713-CLOFAB-in-CLO-SET) in our Help Center. The CLO zFab Kit is now available for order worldwide — pricing, configuration, and demo requests at [zfabkit.clo3d.com](http://zfabkit.clo3d.com). You can also read the [full announcement](https://clo3d.com/en/resources/notices/1439) on the CLO Newsroom.

![587edb86825143e1b9b88613c3ed92b7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/3de990f60a4142f89d89c71343351c6d/images/587edb86825143e1b9b88613c3ed92b7image.png)

## FAQ

**What is CLOFAB?** CLOFAB is a web-based fabric digitization tool in CLO-SET that turns fabric data captured with the CLO zFab Kit — or your existing fabric images — into digital fabric assets you can register and share, with no separate software installation.

**Do I need the CLO zFab Kit to use CLOFAB?** The zFab Kit (Cutter, Scanner, Draper) is at the core of the CLOFAB workflow — it captures high-resolution PBR maps and physical property data directly from physical fabric samples. That said, if you already have fabric images, you can generate seamless maps from them using AI Auto Tiling without the hardware.

**Do I need a CLO software license?** No. CLOFAB runs entirely on the web in CLO-SET, and the zFab Kit operates as a standalone solution — no CLO license is required.

**Who is CLOFAB for?** Fabric suppliers, mills, and brand design teams — anyone who needs to create or work with accurate digital fabrics in a 3D fashion workflow.

**Where do my digitized fabrics go?** Fabrics upload directly to the CLO-SET Workroom or Company Library you choose, where they’re instantly shareable with your team.

* * *

_Ready to digitize your first fabric?_[_Log in to CLO-SET_](https://www.clo-set.com) _and open CLOFAB today._
content_description: CLOFAB in CLO-SET is a web-based tool that enables fabric suppliers and brands to easily create, digitize, and share accurate, simulation-ready digital fabrics within their existing 3D design workflow—no software installation or CLO license required.

title: How to Optimize Fashion Product Development with Practical 3D Workflow Tips - 2026 CLO-SET Webinar
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/ff0bd53d01e64f7788db91074a590f84/images/b440a2b815ba463b98a070f831646d64whatsnew-2-webinar.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/ff0bd53d01e64f7788db91074a590f84/images/092af05277b64375ac4f1c44654ace0a2026%20CLO-SET%20webinar%20FR.png)Fashion product development involves much more than creating 3D garments. Teams collaborate across design, development, merchandising, and production, and the workflow connecting them determines how much time goes to manual work instead of decisions.

In our 10th CLO-SET Skill-up Webinar, we shared practical tips and productivity features for each stage of product development: organizing product information, creating samples, reviewing collections, and measuring development performance.

After the global session, we also held localized webinars for several regions so users could learn these workflows in their preferred language. All recordings are now available on the [CLO-SET YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MzGE34D2bE&list=PL8MWMK6wOJCm3wTyfESanrwpjKUyGT2zN&index=4), where you can revisit any session and watch the full demonstrations.

Below are the workflow improvements covered in the series.

**Key takeaways**

  * Build a structured product foundation before design begins

  * Find and reuse assets more efficiently during sample creation

  * Speed up sample reviews with AI-powered collaboration tools

  * Standardize collection reviews and merchandising workflows

  * Measure product development performance with actionable analytics




**1\. Build better product foundations (product development)**

Features covered

  * Enhanced Compatible Formats

  * Placeholder Creation

  * Overview Tab

  * BOM & POM Tab




Efficient product development starts with organized product information, not the first 3D garment. Before a design is finalized, teams collect inspiration, technical references, materials, and product specifications from multiple sources, and development goes smoother when all of it lives in one workspace.

CLO-SET supports this with broad file format compatibility, placeholder styles, and structured product data in the Overview, BOM, and POM tabs. Teams can set up product data early and keep it connected as the design evolves.

**2\. Speed up sample creation (sample creation)**

Features covered

  * Universal Browser (CLO3D)

  * Workspace Browser

  * Tag & Category

  * Advanced Search




Efficient sample creation depends as much on finding the right assets as on designing quickly. Digital libraries keep growing, and digging through folders stops scaling. Tags, categories, filters, and image-based search let designers locate fabrics, graphics, and reusable styles without breaking their workflow, and direct access to shared libraries from both CLO and CLO-SET cuts extra steps during sample creation.

**3\. Make sample reviews faster (sample review)**

Features covered

  * Quality Check Bot

  * Enhanced Viewer

  * AI Translation

  * Linked Content




Review cycles are often the biggest bottleneck in fashion product development. Instead of reviewing static images or checking every garment by hand, teams can inspect interactive 3D samples, verify construction details, and automate repetitive quality checks. AI translation makes collaboration easier for global teams, and Linked Content keeps related assets and product versions traceable.

Want to see these workflows in action? Watch the complete recordings on the CLO-SET YouTube channel for the full demonstration of each workflow in this article.
